findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_action_items, list_crawlability_scans, get_crawlability_scan, list_accessibility_scans, describe_yellowhead, get_portfolio_changes, start_diagnostic · Private data: list_citation_scans, start_diagnostic · Public sink: list_citation_scans, get_citation_scan, start_diagnostic · Destructive: list_diagnostics, get_diagnostic, get_usage, get_crawlability_scan, get_accessibility_scan, describe_yellowhead, list_portfolio, get_portfolio_changes, start_diagnostic, get_run_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_action_items, list_crawlability_scans, get_crawlability_scan, list_accessibility_scans, describe_yellowhead, get_portfolio_changes, start_diagnostic · Private data: list_citation_scans, start_diagnostic · Public sink: list_citation_scans, get_citation_scan, start_diagnostic · Destructive: list_diagnostics, get_diagnostic, get_usage, get_crawlability_scan, get_accessibility_scan, describe_yellowhead, list_portfolio, get_portfolio_changes, start_diagnostic, get_run_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "start_diagnostic" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
